snippet.title: CODE VEIN II - Producer Diary |  Motorcycle Forma
snippet.description:
If you have to travel through the waste and wreckage of the near-future world, you might as well do it in style. 
Join Producer Keita Iizuka and learn more about the Revenant Hunter’s Motorcycle Forma – a key feature in CODE VEIN II.

Bound By Blood, Experience an epic adventure that transcends time – CODE VEIN II is coming in 2026. Wishlist now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam! www.Playcodevein.com

#CODEVEIN
